description_en: Adds one or more vServer groups of a Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance to a scaling group. After a scaling group is associated with a CLB instance, instances added to the scaling group are automatically added as backend servers of the CLB instance to process access requests forwarded by the CLB instance. To forward different requests to different backend servers or forward requests based on domain names and URLs, you can call the AttachVServerGroups API operation to add one or more vServer groups of the CLB instance and manage different backend servers by using the vServer groups
description_zh: 伸缩组关联负载均衡实例（CLB）后，加入伸缩组的实例会自动添加为CLB实例的后端服务器，处理来自CLB实例转发的访问请求。当需要将不同的请求转发到不同的后端服务器上时，或需要通过域名和URL进行请求转发时，您可以调用API AttachVServerGroups来添加负载均衡实例下的一个或者多个虚拟服务器组，通过虚拟服务器组管理不同的后端服务器
kebab_example: aliyun ess attach-vserver-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --scaling-group-id asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq0000 --vserver-groups '[{"LoadBalancerId":"rsp-bp1jp1rge0000","VServerGroupAttributes":[{}]}]' --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachVServerGroups

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the scaling group belongs. Examples: cn-hangzhou and cn-shanghai. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩组所属地域的ID。如cn-hangzhou、cn-shanghai，更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to add the ECS instances or elastic container instances in the current scaling group to the newly added vServer groups. Valid values:

true: adds the instances.
false: does not add the instances.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否将当前伸缩组内的ECS实例或ECI实例添加到新增的虚拟服务器组。取值范围：

true：添加。
false：不添加。

默认值：false
parameters.name: force_attach

fields.help_en: The ID of the CLB instance to which the vServer group belongs
fields.help_zh: 虚拟服务器组所属负载均衡实例的ID
fields.name: load_balancer_id

fields.help_en: The port number used when Auto Scaling adds the ECS instance or elastic container instance to the vServer group. Valid values: 1 to 65535
fields.help_zh: 弹性伸缩将ECS实例或ECI实例添加到虚拟服务器组时使用的端口号，取值范围：1~65535
fields.name: port

fields.help_en: The ID of the vServer group
fields.name: vserver_group_id

fields.help_en:
The weight configured when Auto Scaling adds the ECS instance or elastic container instance to the vServer group. Valid values: 0 to 100.

Default value: 50
fields.help_zh:
弹性伸缩将ECS实例或ECI实例添加到虚拟服务器组时设置的权重，取值范围：0~100。

默认值：50
fields.name: weight

fields.help_en: The properties of the vServer group
fields.name: vserver_group_attributes

parameters.help_en: The details of the vServer groups associated with the scaling group
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩组关联的虚拟服务器组的信息集合
parameters.name: vserver_groups
